classes.title: Put it together
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, all parts in order
classes.parentTip: If your child gets stuck, sing the next word. Do not fix every note.

classes.title: Left hand helper
classes.goal: Play one low left hand note at the start of each bar
classes.parentTip: You play the tune, your child plays the low notes. Count bars out loud to help.

classes.title: Hands together, slowly
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left hand note on each bar
classes.parentTip: Two hands is hard work. Go very slowly and stop while it's still fun.

classes.title: Play along
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed
classes.parentTip: Keeping up with the music is the goal. Missed notes are fine, just keep going.

segments.caption: Play along at full speed!

Can you do it once more?

classes.title: Concert time
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end and celebrate
classes.parentTip: Clap, cheer and bow together. Mistakes are fine. The fun is playing to someone.
